verdict.rationale: Rootly's API overview docs offer a "Download OpenAPI Specification" link to a swagger.json file, described as usable for exploring endpoints and generating client libraries. A versioned API changelog supports it. The probe's 404s were on guessed docs-domain paths and do not contradict the documented URL. However, the documented swagger.json returns 403 to non-browser clients, so agents may not be able to fetch it directly. missing for 10: verified programmatic (non-browser) retrieval of the spec, independent or hands-on confirmation of the spec's completeness and validity.
